description.value: Starlight Kitchen is a Chinese restaurant located on Kingsway in East Vancouver, one of the city's most active and diverse dining corridors. Situated in unit 206 of a multi-unit building, it serves the dense residential and commercial neighbourhood around the Kingsway and Victoria corridor. Cyclists passing through this part of Vancouver on routes connecting Commercial Drive to Burnaby will find it along a well-travelled urban cycling route.
